about: Account presets. Firm rules (targets, max loss, daily loss, consistency, trading days) are from each firm's own published rules, checked 2026-10-21 (rules_source per firm); risk per trade, caps and floors are the trader's own numbers. Firms change their rules: check the firm's page before trading.

FTMO US (OANDA).note: FTMO for US residents (Florida included), run with OANDA. Same trading objectives as FTMO: 2-Step 10% / 5% targets, 5% daily loss, 10% max loss, 4 trading days. Capital cap $400K per trader or strategy across all accounts, before scaling (+25% every 4 months up to $2M).
